decisions.reason: Continue representation research around the provisional linear-moment result: validation macro AUC 0.828326 exceeds zero, copy and quadratic controls by 0.000756, 0.000444 and 0.000261 at identical parameter count. All four tasks improve AUC and Logloss versus the shared reference and topic entry; buy AUC nevertheless falls 0.000128 versus zero moments. Linear uses 32,948,357 parameters and 31.36 s inference versus baseline 32,059,429 and 26.61 s; its training trial cost 406.31 s. Prioritize repeat confirmation and controlled attribution of order information versus redundant content or optimization effects. One seed does not establish mechanism. The existing relation/count merge remains below its stronger frozen source, so compatibility is unresolved and does not justify another merge now.

task_tradeoffs.is_click: Versus baseline and topic entry: AUC +0.015887, Logloss -0.002000. Linear also exceeds zero moments by 0.001346 AUC; repeat support is absent.
task_tradeoffs.cart: Versus baseline and topic entry: AUC +0.018072, Logloss -0.002389. Linear exceeds zero moments by only 0.000073 AUC and trails quadratic by 0.000447; task-specific moment benefit is uncertain.
task_tradeoffs.fav: Versus baseline and topic entry: AUC +0.015764, Logloss -0.001656. Linear exceeds zero moments by 0.001731 AUC; this is the largest task contribution to that macro gain, without repeat confirmation.
task_tradeoffs.buy: Versus baseline and topic entry: AUC +0.023889, Logloss -0.001534. Versus zero moments, AUC regresses 0.000128 while Logloss improves 0.000053. Parked count shrinkage has higher buy AUC (0.897081 versus 0.894071), but lower macro AUC; retain this trade-off under the frozen equal-task selection policy.

decisions.reason: Continue g0: best validation four-task macro ROC-AUC is 0.830378918 (+0.020455530 versus baseline/entry), with every task improving in AUC and logloss. The four recent memory variants span only 0.000180697 AUC at equal parameter count; their single-seed ordering does not establish a mechanism. Prioritize repetition and replacement/capacity controls, reserving assessment budget. Best costs 33,022,405 parameters (+3.0%) and 38.33 s inference (+44.1%) versus baseline; its macro logloss is slightly worse than factorized-separate (0.054651390 versus 0.054643055), consistent with selecting by macro AUC. Further gains and their cost justification remain unresolved.

task_tradeoffs.is_click: Best versus baseline/entry: AUC +0.017635439; logloss -0.002121417. Versus factorized-separate, AUC improves but logloss worsens; single-seed differences remain uncertain.
task_tradeoffs.cart: Best versus baseline/entry: AUC +0.018770692; logloss -0.002482334. Factorized-separate has slightly better cart AUC and logloss; aggregate AUC selection accepts this trade-off.
task_tradeoffs.fav: Best versus baseline/entry: AUC +0.018261477; logloss -0.001742114. AUC is essentially tied with factorized-separate, with slightly lower logloss; no repeated support yet.
task_tradeoffs.buy: Best versus baseline/entry: AUC +0.027154510; logloss -0.001540382. Versus factorized-separate, AUC improves with slightly worse logloss; uncertainty is material with 4,036 validation positives and one seed.

decisions.reason: Continue g0-t000. Occupancy leads validation four-task macro ROC-AUC at 0.831886842 (+0.021963454 versus baseline/entry; +0.000477323 versus zero; +0.000465382 versus within). All tasks improve over entry, but click regresses versus zero/within and cart/fav Logloss regresses versus within. Equal-parameter full replay is only 0.000028392 behind: occupancy sufficiency and order effects remain unresolved at the fixed seed. Retain zero, within and full replay as utility/attribution controls, subject to next-phase implementation inspection; confirmation must distinguish mechanism contrasts from repetition. The recent variants each have 33,130,405 parameters and measured inference of 45.22-46.41 s; occupancy costs 3.34% more parameters and 69.97% more inference time than baseline. Existing merged branches trail the current best and do not establish complementarity. Recent runs cost 570-589 s, so prioritize a small discriminating continuation with resources reserved for necessary attribution, repetition and assessment within the remaining 3010 s. These observations are provisional, not mechanism confirmation.

task_tradeoffs.is_click: Occupancy versus baseline/reference and topic entry (same model): AUC +0.017804096, Logloss -0.002108602. Versus zero: AUC -0.000059683, Logloss +0.000045536; versus within: AUC -0.000157004, Logloss +0.000028665. The macro-AUC gain accepts this small click regression; repeatability is unknown.
task_tradeoffs.cart: Occupancy versus baseline/reference and topic entry: AUC +0.020546974, Logloss -0.002563861. Versus zero: AUC +0.000826411, Logloss -0.000042067; versus within: AUC +0.000756782 but Logloss +0.000054720. Ranking and Logloss trade off versus within; fixed-seed evidence is provisional.
task_tradeoffs.fav: Occupancy versus baseline/reference and topic entry: AUC +0.020397046, Logloss -0.001815989. Versus zero: AUC +0.000636259, Logloss -0.000029222; versus within: AUC +0.000567310 but Logloss +0.000060004. Full replay also exceeds occupancy AUC by 0.000189611 with Logloss lower by 0.000001967; occupancy is not uniformly superior.
task_tradeoffs.buy: Occupancy versus baseline/reference and topic entry: AUC +0.029105698, Logloss -0.001719500. Versus zero: AUC +0.000506305, Logloss -0.000045317; versus within: AUC +0.000694441, Logloss -0.000022120. Versus full replay: AUC +0.000082401, Logloss -0.000034739. Both measures favor occupancy, but only 4036 validation positives and a fixed seed limit confidence.
